description: This file contains functions and constants for managing cron schedules, including cache management, schedule resolution, and computation of next and previous run times based on cron expressions or absolute times.

methods.name: resolveCronTimezone
methods.description: Resolves the timezone string, defaulting to the system's timezone if none provided.

methods.name: resolveCachedCron
methods.description: Retrieves a cached Cron object or creates and caches a new one based on the expression and timezone.

methods.name: resolveCronFromSchedule
methods.description: Extracts and resolves a Cron object from a schedule object containing timezone and cron expression.
